It also covers the MF Source design-time path with the config caveat (DTSX:9-11, 33) and the not-proven same-file note (finding#2 exists). They are cast with (DT_R8) and written to gen_mfaccumulation and gen_mfdeposit (convert DTSX:3820; Set Pension/Study Fund Columns DTSX:5917/5975). No other package references these attributes. results.detail: The seven steps and their triggers match the DTSX. Constraint is 8053, Constraint 1 is 8054, Constraint 4 is 8057 (EvalOp=3 @[User::isFileExist]), and Constraint 2 is 8055. Constraint 6 (8059) and Constraint 5 (8058, EvalOp=3 !@[User::isFileExist]) have no DTS:LogicalAnd, so they are OR. Constraint 3 is 8056. No executable is disabled. The MF label is marked השערה.

The SQL is CASE WHEN SUM(ISNULL(bal,0)) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(ISNULL(bal,0) * pct) / SUM(ISNULL(bal,0)) END. A NULL pct makes the product NULL, so SUM skips it in the numerator while the denominator includes the balance. All data-dependent outcomes are stated conditionally and are arithmetically correct. If all pct are NULL and the sum is non-zero, the result is NULL. When both stored values exist, Update3 (NULL != x) fails with FailComponent; when one stored value is NULL, order 0 or 1 catches the row first. Accounts without employers or funds get 0/0. The ownership argument for the stored-value columns uses the ambiguity rule and the AccountBase evidence (DTSX:7991-7993). It treats the 'account' view as exposing the AccountBase columns, which is CRM convention and is the same assumption the Unsupported classification relies on. The finding is not framed as a bug.

MF Source has no PropertyExpression (DTSX:9-24). TRIM only trims, and with RetainNulls=false the convert expressions map "" to NULL. Unit [1] of the same claim says the files do not define the meaning of these columns, so this is an unproven meaning and an internal inconsistency.
